risks.title: Risque économique et cyclicité des marchés
risks.score_rationale: L'entreprise est exposée aux fluctuations des marchés et aux conditions économiques générales. Le 10-K souligne que toute baisse ou croissance inférieure aux attentes des marchés servis diminuerait la demande de produits et services, affectant négativement les résultats financiers. Les pressions inflationnistes continuent à des niveaux élevés. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: L'entreprise est vulnérable aux fluctuations économiques, à la cyclicité des marchés qu'elle sert et aux pressions inflationnistes persistantes.

risks.title: Risque de change
risks.score_rationale: L'entreprise est exposée aux fluctuations des taux de change, ayant une exposition substantielle aux revenus internationales. Le rapport indique que les fluctuations des taux de change pourraient affecter négativement les revenus signalés et la rentabilité lors de la traduction en dollars américains. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: L'entreprise est exposée aux risques liés aux fluctuations des taux de change affectant revenus et cash flows internationaux.

risks.title: Risque de concurrence
risks.score_rationale: L'entreprise opère dans des marchés hautement compétitifs de la recherche en sciences de la vie, des instruments analytiques et des diagnostics. La diversité des segments ne réduit pas l'intensité concurrentielle. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: L'entreprise fait face à une concurrence intense dans ses quatre segments d'activité.

company_description: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. provides life sciences solutions, analytical instruments, specialty diagnostics, and laboratory products and biopharma services in the North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Life Sciences Solutions, Analytical Instruments, Specialty Diagnostics, and Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services. The Life Sciences Solutions segment includes reagents, instruments, and consumables for biological and medical research; discovery and production of drugs and vaccines; and diagnosis of infections and diseases. Its Analytical Instruments segment provides instruments, consumables, software, and services for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, government, environmental, and other research and industrial markets, as well as clinical laboratories. The Specialty Diagnostics segment offers clinical diagnostics products, such as liquid ready-to-use and lyophilized immunodiagnostic reagent kits, calibrators, controls, protein detection assays, and instruments; immunodiagnostic offerings comprising developing, manufacturing, and marketing of complete blood-test systems for the clinical diagnosis and monitoring of allergy, asthma and autoimmune diseases; microbiology offerings, such as dehydrated and prepared culture media, collection and transport systems, instrumentation and consumables to detect pathogens in blood, diagnostic and rapid direct specimen tests, quality-control products, and associated products; transplant diagnostics products, including human leukocyte antigen typing and testing for the organ transplant market; and healthcare market channel offerings. Its Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services segment provides laboratory products, research and safety market channel, and pharma services and clinical research. Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.
